snippet.title: [UE5] RAVENOUS Teaser - Student game
snippet.description:
Here is the Itch.io link to the game: https://ekoay.itch.io/ravenous
Ravenous is a psychological horror game in which you play as Louis, a child trapped in a monster's basement. Explore the mysterious abode, solve puzzles to save your little sister and survive the psychological nightmare it has prepared for you.

Key features
- A first-person horrific experience focused on the tragic story of the White family, with cinematics.
- Explore an atmospheric Victorian basement and solve the mystery of each room to save your little sister.


INFORMATIONS
Ravenous is a French student project from the Esma Game school. The project was made in 6 months, from conception to completion. The team is made up of 7 students who can be found in the authors and credits.
